title: multi-gpu-pipelined-collectives-and-scheduler-tuning-for-tensor-parallel-inference
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: Tensor-parallel inference on multi-GPU clusters showed recurring idle periods where ranks blocked waiting on collectives. This PR introduces a pipelined scheduling approach and NCCL/CUDA-level tuning to increase overlap between communication and compute, reduce tail latency, and improve throughput for long sequences and high-token-rate workloads.

Summary of changes: added a pipelined microbatch scheduler that staggers microbatches across TP ranks, introduced per-layer non-blocking collectives on dedicated CUDA streams with explicit stream synchronization points, optimized host-pinned buffer allocation for NCCL rendezvous, and refined KV-cache sharding to reduce cross-rank fanout during KV fetch. Also added heuristics to dynamically choose microbatch size and number of in-flight pipeline stages based on runtime latency samples.

Compatibility and safety: changes are gated behind a runtime flag (TP_PIPELINED_COLLECTIVES=true) and default to previous behavior. The merge includes feature gates, extensive logging, a perf benchmark harness, and a rollback env var to disable pipelining cluster-wide. No API surface changes.

Testing and validation: unit tests for scheduler invariants, integration tests for correctness under synthetic workloads, and perf runs on 8xA100 instances. Benchmarks are included in perf/tp_overlap_bench. See benchmark_results field for measured gains.

Runtime knobs added (config keys): runtime.tp.pipelined_collectives, runtime.tp.max_inflight_stages, runtime.tp.nccl_stream_count, runtime.tp.dynamic_microbatching.

Deployment notes: flip the runtime flag in canary first (10%), monitor token-level latency p95 and per-rank GPU utilization; fallback to TP_PIPELINED_COLLECTIVES=false if error rates or p95 regressions >10% observed.
commits: init: add pipeline scheduler scaffolding and feature gate
perf: implement per-layer non-blocking allreduce using dedicated NCCL/CUDA streams
infra: pinned host buffer pool and rendezvous optimization for NCCL
kv: shard-aware KV cache fetch to reduce cross-rank broadcasts
tests: add integration tests and perf harness for tp overlap
docs: runtime flags and rollout guidance
fix: synchronize stream ordering on fallback paths and add retries
review_comments: Diego Ramos: Nice work — the per-layer stream model looks promising. Two asks: (1) ensure fallback path avoids deadlocks if NCCL returns an error mid-stage, (2) clarify memory accounting for pinned buffers.
Asha Menon (author): Addressed both — added a retry+abort policy in nccl_transport.cu and incorporated pinned buffer accounting into the allocator; expanded logs to emit pool usage metrics.

Priya Kapoor: Can we make dynamic_microbatching opt-in per-model? Ops teams prefer conservative defaults. Also observed a 2% increase in CPU usage on the controller during our canary; is that expected?

Asha Menon: dynamic_microbatching is behind runtime.tp.dynamic_microbatching (default false). Increased controller CPU is from additional telemetry; added sampling reduction and optimized the stats aggregation loop to bring it back in line.
Jun Park: test flakiness near network partitions — would like an automated chaos test.
Asha Menon: added a simple network-partition integration test that simulates delayed collectives and verifies recovery via the retry path.
release_notes: Improves multi-GPU tensor-parallel throughput and latency by pipelining microbatches and overlapping collectives with compute. Adds runtime flags to enable/disable pipelined collectives and dynamic microbatching. Includes perf harness and rollout guidance.
benchmark_results: 8xA100 synthetic long-seq (seq_len=4096, batch=4): throughput +1.31x, p95 latency -14%
8xA100 steady-token-rate test: sustained throughput +1.22x, GPU utilization increased from 62%->88%
Small-batch microbench (batch=1, seq=512): latency stable within +/-3% (no regression)
rollout_plan: Canary 10% for 24h -> 50% for 6h -> full rollout. Monitor p95 token latency, per-rank GPU util, error-rate. Rollback by setting TP_PIPELINED_COLLECTIVES=false on controller or using the scripts/deploy/enable_tp_pipelining.sh to toggle off.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover scheduler invariants and stream ordering. Integration tests validate correctness of allreduce/concat paths under normal and partitioned networks. Perf harness run nightly against a dedicated perf-lab pool; observed stable telemetry and improved GPU utilization.
